text: When validating invoices, first extract subtotal and tax fields, then compare tax against the applicable rule before approving the result.
Prefer local or offline model execution for benchmark workflows unless an explicit task requires an external service.
When the requester asks for Persian output, preserve technical terms clearly and write the final report in Persian.
Security-sensitive workflow decisions must record the action, reason, source evidence, and approval state in an audit log.
Avoid sending sensitive content to external services; redact secrets and prefer local processing for private documents.
Before irreversible or externally visible actions, require human approval and record the approval decision.
For factual answers, retrieve supporting context before generation and cite or reference the evidence used.
When comparing strategies, report both quality and latency so improvements can be weighed against runtime cost.
Match the requested output language while keeping identifiers, code names, and metric labels stable.
Do not finalize claims until the relevant grounding evidence has been selected and checked for fit.
